item.title: 🎓 From Vet School to First Job: Your Step-by-Step Guide | VJM USA Canada
item.description: Your clinical skills are ready. But securing your first job uses a completely different toolkit, and most vet programs barely cover it. When should you start looking? How do you stand out as a new grad? What do you say when they ask about salary? The answers are simpler than you'd expect, but getting them right means the difference between stressful and starting next week...

item.title: 🚰 Revenue Leaks Draining Your Practice? How To Fix Them | VJM
item.description: Visit numbers are sliding and the post-pandemic pet boost is waning. But before you think about new marketing strategies or bigger budgets, there are almost certainly clients slipping through the cracks right now for reasons that cost almost nothing to fix. Check if your practice is quietly losing revenue like this, and what you can do to fix things this week...

item.title: 💰 How to Ask for a Raise (Without things getting Awkward) | VJM
item.description: You work hard, you're good at what you do, and you've been patiently waiting for "that chat" to come up. But actually asking for a raise? That's where many veterinary professionals stall. The wrong timing, the wrong words, or just not knowing where to start can turn a reasonable discussion into an uncomfortable moment. There's a smarter way to approach this conversation, and it starts well before you walk into your boss's office. Find out how...

item.title: 🛠️ The Skills 2027 Will Demand: What To Start Learning Now | VJM
item.description: Every profession has moments where a handful of people spot what's coming next and move early. Veterinary medicine is in one of those moments right now. The abilities that will set you apart in 2027 aren't about what you do in surgery or how you read a blood panel. They're being driven by what today's clients are already exploring and where their expectations are heading next. Find out which five to focus on and where to start...

item.title: 🌟 What Is Your North Star? The Best Leaders Have One | VJM
item.description: Your team watches what you do more than what you say. So when tough decisions stack up and the schedule gets chaotic, what's guiding your calls? Purpose-driven Leadership gives you and your practice a clear North Star that shapes culture, steadies morale, and turns values into visible action. Find out how to build yours with seven practical steps you can start this week...

item.title: 🏗️ Gen Z & Millennials: Building Your Practice's Future | VJM
item.description: Millennials and Gen Z are rapidly becoming the backbone of veterinary care. The practices getting retention and recruitment right aren't making random moves. They've figured out what up-and-coming professionals actually want and built it into how they operate at every level. From mental health support woven into the daily routine to job ads that tell engaging stories, find out what's giving these practices the edge...

item.title: 🔥 Team burnout: 3 hidden warning signs + 3 solutions | VJM
item.description: Burnout creeps in silently. Your best nurse starts watching the clock. Your experienced vet stops mentoring. Small changes you dismiss as "personality clashes" or "off days." But practice owners who spot these early warning signs and act fast keep their teams strong, while others lose their best people. Here's how to recognize and prevent it...

item.title: 💸 Compensation Revolution: 5 Models Reshaping Veterinary Pay | VJM
item.description: While many in the profession are still debating whether ProSal is fair, these practices pose a completely different question: How do we reward people so well that they never want to leave? item.title: 📲 What If Your Next Vet Role Didn't Require a Commute? | VJM
item.description: You already have the clinical skills telehealth employers are looking for. But knowing that and knowing how to actually land one of these roles are two very different things.
